method: Read-only inspection of current local frontend, API routes, use cases, repositories and CSS. No runtime capability flags or remote account data asserted; no application implementation or publication.

explicitConstraints.historyNavigation: Removed from desktop/mobile primary navigation. Keep /history and /history/:id as secondary routes reached from meeting materials/recordings; do not restore a primary History item.
excluded: admin user management or feature toggle editing
explicitConstraints.recordingPlayer: Simple standalone video/audio player with information and actual files; no AI/transcript/top-level recording tabs.
explicitConstraints.noMutations: Only this audit JSON is created; application/backend/source/Git index/remote host unchanged.

navigation.auth: All routes are inside Protected/Layout. Anonymous sessions go through authentication; guest sessions are redirected to their conference rather than account sections.
navigation.capabilityNav: Analytics only after successful current meetingAnalytics=true; Admin only user.isAdmin=true, with backend enforcement on every request.

conference.titleSemantics: Recording display title is the meeting title, not a separately editable recording title.

userVisibleMetadata: recording start date with creation-date fallback

history.limitations: Only finished/cancelled meetings; participant list capped at 100. Owners/co-hosts can see broader historical membership than ordinary participants, whose view filters admission_state=admitted. Count is historical memberships, not peak simultaneous attendance.

analytics.limitations: One meeting only; participant array capped at 500, timeline capped to about 600 points. Speaking is an approximate audio-level observation, not a transcript-derived ranking or productivity measure. Missing observation must not be called silence.

admin.limitations: Read-only service operations summary. No users table, user-role editor, queue/job controls, resource restarts or feature settings API on this page.

permissions.rule: Authenticated current conference member with admitted/legacy-compatible admission and status joined or left. Waiting/rejected/kicked members cannot read history, recording list/detail, transcript, summary or analytics.
read-materials plus conference status finished or cancelled.
Any admitted joined permanent account in active conference, when no unfinished recording exists. Guest accounts forbidden; not organizer-only.

Permanent account with historical read access AND conference owner with owner role, OR original recording requestedBy. Co-host role alone is insufficient. Current frontend only offers stop while that account is joined.
Owner/co-host and server enabled/canRetry or enabled/canRegenerate. Backend enforces readiness, provider mode, maximum generations and cooldown. Do not assume permission from role alone.
Global persisted administrator privilege, not conference owner/co-host and not stale JWT. RequireAdmin queries current IsAdmin for every /admin request.

capabilities.designPolicy: Hide conditional material sections/nav until current successful flag confirmation. Render disabled/unavailable/error states, not fabricated working AI/analytics. Per-content endpoint enabled/canRetry/canRegenerate/providerMode remains authoritative beyond global flags. Mark mock material as demo.
capabilities.runtimeFlags: Not inspected; feature-enabled mockups must be explicitly conditional scenarios.

retentionAndLinks.availability: Terminal ready/partial_ready/failed/cancelled recordings are hidden after 7 days from COALESCE(ended_at,stopped_at,updated_at,created_at), and deleted_at is always excluded.
retentionAndLinks.signedFileLinks: Backend produces private presigned object GET links valid for 24 hours. UI does not have an explicit expiry field. A signed file URL is not the same as a permission-protected page URL; copy action currently copies the page.
retentionAndLinks.designConstraint: Do not claim permanent storage, 30/90-day archive retention, public sharing, or show a precise expiry countdown unsupported by DTO.

designFindings.finding: Current UI does not explain 7-day recording availability; 30/90-day local date filters could imply retention that does not exist.
designFindings.decision: Use neutral supported retention explanation; no exact expiry timer without DTO. Do not draw permanent library.

designFindings.finding: Search/filter/sort scope is loaded data, not server-wide content. Record list has no total.
designFindings.decision: Preserve explicit selected-meeting context, 'по загруженным' wording and Load more. No global record count/catalog.

designFindings.finding: <=600 recording row hides Watch/organizer, metadata10px and preview104px; differs from full-width adaptive card requested.
designFindings.decision: Full-width preview card + explicit Watch and menu; unknown metadata omitted, not fabricated.

designFindings.finding: Recording list action trigger is36px desktop/32px mobile; view switches min40px and Watch38px. Some desktop material downloads38px. Prompt requires44x44.
designFindings.decision: 44x44 minimum hit areas across widths with visible focus; menu retains keyboard Escape/arrows/Home/End and focus return.

designFindings.finding: Top History sections and RecordingInsights inner tabs duplicate section selection; top recording also gets insights.
designFindings.decision: One material navigation level in meeting history; standalone recording player remains no tabs.

designFindings.finding: Legacy History RecordingPanel uses default20 without load-more; mature history list may omit later ready recordings.
designFindings.decision: Document gap; do not mock complete historical recording count/list unless current API pages are explicitly loaded in implementation.

designFindings.finding: Backend PublicStatus leaves partial_ready unchanged and history ready count includes it, but ConferenceRecording TS union omits it and playableRecordings accepts only ready.
designFindings.decision: Do not draw a ready Watch action for partial_ready; describe unavailable/non-playable materials neutrally. API/contract reconciliation is a separate implementation gap.

designFindings.finding: History list/detail and analytics show failure without an explicit retry; recording list has retries but no normal-state refresh.
designFindings.decision: Design consistent Retry and refresh states that re-use existing GET APIs, not new backend operations.

designFindings.finding: History list unconditionally mentions transcript/AI/analytics; actual capabilities can be off/unverified.
designFindings.decision: General 'доступные материалы' wording or confirmed capability-specific hint; never fake enabled results.

designFindings.finding: Current analytics table min-width690px; horizontal scroll is supported but requested mobile design should not mechanically shrink desktop.
designFindings.decision: Alphabetical participant cards preserving all actual six metrics; text-accessible timeline; no leaderboard.

designFindings.finding: Standalone recording video has no <track> source or caption file DTO; transcript text is a separate conditional history material.
designFindings.decision: Do not invent player CC or transcript tab. Preserve native keyboard playback controls and meaningful media labels.

designFindings.finding: Historical member count is role-filtered and capped list, not peak attendance; cancelled meetings may have no duration.
designFindings.decision: Label 'участники встречи', indicate partial list, keep null duration dash; never invent attendance chart from this count.

designFindings.finding: Summary task source links only appear when matching transcript segments have already been loaded; direct summary tab does not preload transcript segments.
designFindings.decision: Do not draw every task with a working source chip unconditionally; show only actual loaded matches.

designFindings.finding: Old /records and debug recording APIs explicitly return410; no conference recording DELETE/favorite/catalog endpoint is registered.
designFindings.decision: Exclude deletion/favorites/global catalog; do not resurrect legacy API.

reusableComponents.restriction: Do not interchange user meeting metrics with global operations metrics.

implementationPriorityIfUserLaterAuthori: P0: Lock selected-meeting IA, secondary History and unsupported-action exclusions; truthful retention/capability/data-scope copy.
P1: Mobile full-width recording cards, 44px targets, one-level History material navigation, consistent retry/refresh.
P1: Analytics mobile participant cards and conditional unavailable/permission screens.
P2: Optional metadata disclosure and advanced state consistency; no backend implementation automatically.
